reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text:
I subscribed to this app for convenience, but I ended up having to double-check Instagram profiles to see if people had actually unfollowed me, which defeats the purpose of using the app in the first place.

The app sometimes says someone has unfollowed me, but when I check their Instagram profile, we’re still following each other. Other times, it lists accounts that no longer exist. I can’t tell whether those accounts have been deactivated or if the app is randomly listing accounts to make it look like people have unfollowed me.

What makes it even more questionable is that I recognize the people who follow me, and some of the accounts the app claims have unfollowed me belong to people I don’t even know or have never interacted with.

I subscribed to save time and make tracking my followers easier, but instead, I have to verify the information myself. If I still need to double-check everything, what’s the point of paying for this app? I decided to cancel my subscription because the results simply aren’t reliable enough to trust.

reviews.title: Stopped Updating Non-Followers
reviews.text: This app has completely stopped working. I’ve had this app for months. I paid for the 1 year subscription to see who blocked/unfollowed/viewed my profile and other perks. However, I realized it barely works. Only one feature works properly, which is immediate update on showing who followed you. Although it gives updates on new followers, it takes at least 1 week to update those that unfollow me. This defeats the entire purpose because that’s the reason I’ve purchased this app: to see who unfollowed me, but left me as a follower so I can quickly unfollow them too. ALSO, there are 2 tabs for who blocked you versus who you’ve blocked but its glitchy. If YOU block somebody then it shows up under “who blocked you” which isn’t the same thing. 3rd thing, it also doesn’t show you the number of times somebody viewed your profile, it only says “viewed once” even if a user viewed your page more than once. NOW, the app has stopped working. It isn’t showing any updates, doesn’t let me refresh, it says “unfollowing in progress” after I tried to unfollow someone from inside this app, and it won’t let me stop the ‘unfollowing’ in progress. This is absolutely ridiculous, and theres no option to contact support through the app either.

reviews.title: Subject: Request for Refund – Report+ App
reviews.text:
Dear ReportTeam,

I am writing to formally request a refund for my purchase of your app. Although it may not be a large amount, it is still my money, and I believe I am entitled to a refund. Unfortunately, the app has proven completely irrelevant to my needs. I have been unable to use core functions, such as performing mass unfollows or any significant interactions. Additionally, the app fails during data downloads, taking around 20 minutes, only to end in error, despite having no issues with other apps. I reached out to Instagram support, and they confirmed no problems on their side. As a result, I cannot recommend this app to anyone.

I kindly ask you to process my refund at your earliest convenience. I look forward to your prompt response.
